purpose: One observed gardening interaction while maintaining needs and responsibilities; preserve the goal across deferral.
input_authority: Independent screen_admit per action; this service never grants input authority.
recovery: Inspect existing need interactions. Failed remedies defer gardening without a purchase, placement, construction or approval prerequisite.
continuity_rules: one fresh exact-target affordance at a time
explicit player override and critical needs still win
verified per-target outcomes only; no blind cancellation
Opt-in fertilizer_workflow applies the same pocket inventory prerequisite to resumed tasks; no bypass through task_continuity

fertilizer_workflow.enrollment: Explicit current-capture gardening.fertilizer_workflow with verified selected Sim, plant targets, and inventory stock
fertilizer_workflow.prerequisite: Fertilizer in GROUND or HOUSEHOLD_INVENTORY does not count as personally carried; exact observed transfer into SIM_INVENTORY plus readback before fertilizing
fertilizer_workflow.batch: Only select native FERTILIZE_ALL if genuinely enabled and personal inventory holds sufficient stock; otherwise one observed exact-target FERTILIZE
fertilizer_workflow.continuity: Existing task_continuity player's goal, queue origin, duplicate guard and verified per-plant outcomes outrank new work
fertilizer_workflow.authority: One proposal per pass; never executes keyboard/mouse, purchases, saves or cancels.
fertilizer_workflow.waiting_behavior: While stock missing, target cooling down or picker absent: one observed gardening maintenance action may be selected, without changing verified fertilization progress; exact player-task continuity never falls back.

sourcing.activation: Legacy uses sourcing with an empty verified pocket. Enrolled quality tracking uses the exact verified shortfall after the lot supply check.
sourcing.eligibility: Current actor/capture/queue/needs/player; only observed affordable and unreserved inputs; one source action

backyard_bags.opt_in: Only current selected Sim and authoritative same-lot bag survey supplied as fertilizer_workflow.backyard_scan; no world scanning daemon created.
backyard_bags.priority: Existing purchased, available, household-owned bags on verified backyard lot outrank any new purchases or other fertilizer-sourcing proposals whenever a verified survey is supplied.
backyard_bags.discovery: Exact current game build, capture, active Sim, lot and personal inventory destination; EA read-only object identity evidence (>=1) or calibrated multiview identity (>=2 distinct); known eligible fertilizer resource; lot and reachable route proof; no player-reserved or protected objects.
backyard_bags.transfer: One fresh observed TRANSFER_FERTILIZER_TO_SIM_INVENTORY affordance with target equal to proven bag_ref; exactly one bag unit proposed, rank accessible bags by observed bounded route steps; no inferred dragging, no actual game effect.
backyard_bags.waiting: QUEUED or AWAITING_INVENTORY_READBACK prevents duplicate pickup; only new independently observed SIM_INVENTORY quantities count as fertilizer available for the existing observed Fertilize menu and verified plant outcome.
backyard_bags.fallbacks: Stale survey, target mismatch, unresolved candidates or an incomplete survey preserve sourcing/inspection. Enrolled quality tracking may plan a reviewed affordable purchase after a complete verified empty lot survey.
backyard_bags.parent_guard: The parent fertilizer_workflow must independently attest the same selected lot_ref and game_build as backyard_scan. The current selected Sim ref and capture must agree. When personally held stock is already sufficient, a stale backyard survey is bypassed and the existing fresh plant picker wins.
backyard_bags.spatial_map: Optional current betterinstincts.semantic-spatial-map-doc/v1 with same game_build and lot_id, non-executing map and keyed objects; candidate item_ref must map to OUTSIDE FERTILIZER_BAG with source-proven 3D pose. Mismatched map scope fails closed; unknown object or pose cannot be chosen.

hover_identity.activation: Optional identity_source=HOVER_TOOLTIP on a backyard bag with bounded hover_observation and current item_ref; title exactly Super Fertilizer and description identifies special fertilizer.
hover_identity.identity: Independent exact highlighted_target_ref and pointer_target_ref must both match current bag item_ref and capture; matching tooltip alone cannot prove an EA object ID.
hover_identity.screenshots: USER_SCREENSHOT may identify source candidate only; no current actor/lot/build/route, no enabled drag interaction, no inventory movement or fertilizer menu eligibility proved.
hover_identity.current_host: HOST_VERIFIED_HOVER can identify a currently highlighted exact bag but still needs all the original lot, actor, eligibility, personal inventory, player, route and enabled exact transfer affordance gates.
hover_identity.price: The visible §80 is an item display value, not a purchase price or authorization to buy/sell.
hover_identity.spatial: Canonical semantic map may classify SUPER_FERTILIZER or legacy FERTILIZER_BAG; world pose must remain source-proven, never inferred from one still screenshot.

backyard_bags.pocket_precedence: Verified personal pocket stock meeting all ready plants bypasses optional backyard scan, including pending or malformed scans; positive partial stock can still fertilize one eligible plant if no bag transfer candidate is ready; batch requires full stock.
backyard_bags.readback: A transfer proposal never credits fertilizer. Post-transfer proof needs fresh independent personal-inventory observation with a genuinely distinct capture reference and separate plant outcome.

quality_tracking.activation: Optional same-capture quality_tracking with verified active lot, household scope and explicit census completeness.
quality_tracking.progress: Optional calibrated fraction within the current tier. Text or an uncalibrated screenshot leaves it unknown. Enabled exact-target EVOLVE is required before recommending an evolution.
quality_tracking.goal: Report observed Perfect coverage and keep watering, weeding, pest care and fertilizer as independent maintenance.
quality_tracking.demand: One inventory unit per observed eligible plant with DEPLETED, NONE or LOW fertilizer in this bounded pass. GOOD and UNKNOWN and cooling targets do not generate purchases.
quality_tracking.purchase: Require verified complete empty on-lot survey, no available owned transfers, one observed PURCHASE_FERTILIZER offer, verified personal-inventory delivery and current funds bound to the same household, lot and game build. Cap quantity at demand minus pocket stock and at available funds above the canonical household reserve.
quality_tracking.arrival: Retain pending_acquisition after a dispatched transfer or purchase. Wait for exact item and full planned quantity in a new verified personal-inventory capture for the same Sim/lot.
quality_tracking.batch: FERTILIZE_ALL requires a current exact observed target set equal to eligible deficient plants plus sufficient stock. Otherwise select one enabled exact plant action.
